children: Adelphi Metals Inc. closed its non-brokered private placement, issuing 6.285M units at C$0.10 each for C$628.5K in gross proceeds. Net proceeds are expected to support mineral assets, potential acquisitions and working capital; no prior-period comparison was provided.
Provides funding for exploration and working capital, but the release gives no comparison with prior financing or cash needs.
Each unit includes one share and one warrant
The financing also creates potential future share dilution if warrants are exercised.
Warrants exercisable at C$0.15 for 24 months
Exercise would provide additional capital but increase the share count; the exercise price is above the unit price.
Shows an officer participated in the financing, but the release provides no ownership or prior participation comparison.

This is a completed financing for a junior exploration company, rather than a new operating result. Further project updates or details on use of proceeds would be needed to establish a larger catalyst.
